subject: general
question: Who elects the members of the Estimates Committee in the Indian Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Members of the Lok Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Estimates Committee is constituted every year by the Parliament of India.
 
• Members of this committee are elected exclusively by the **Members of the Lok Sabha (House of the People).**
 
• The committee consists of **30 members**, all of whom are drawn from the Lok Sabha.
 
• Rajya Sabha (Council of States) members are not involved in the election or composition of this committee.
 
• The function of the Estimates Committee is to examine the estimates included in the budget and suggest economies in public expenditure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Origin of the Committee**

 
 
• The Estimates Committee was first established in **1950** under the Government of India Act, 1935.
 
• The provisions for its formation were later incorporated into the Constitution of India.
 
 
 
• **Key Responsibilities**
 
 
• The committee examines whether the proposed expenditure is necessary and whether funds are being utilized effectively.
 
• It also suggests measures to ensure efficiency in administration.
 
 
 
• **Chairperson**
 
 
• The chairperson of the Estimates Committee is appointed by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha from amongst its members.
 
• Traditionally, the chairperson is selected from the ruling party or coalition.
 
 
 
• **Limitations**
 
 
• The committee does not have the authority to examine policy issues or demand grants.
 
• Its focus is restricted to scrutinizing the technical and financial aspects of the estimates.
